primary_recommendation: Diagnose seed-specific vote separability and training-domain learnability before adding a bounded training budget.

confirmed_recipe_difference.causal_status: hypothesis requiring a controlled test; not an established implementation bug

steps.inputs: Six complete existing training crops from three source regions, fixed augmentation and voxel fixtures; selected without model-result filtering
steps.gate: Resolve interface failures first; separate learned XY failure from inference-statistics failure

steps.purpose: Two-complete-crop micro-fit; optional matched-parent LR ratio 1.0 versus 0.1 arms
steps.proposed_engineering_gate: At least 50 percent lower XY error than zero prediction on both fitting inputs, more compact same-tree votes, finite and stable states; report separate non-fitting crop behavior
steps.negative_result_interpretation: Failed within the fixed diagnostic budget, not proof that the architecture can never learn
steps.lr_variant_rules: Preserve identical parent net/Adam state/RNG/input; change only keyword-block relative LR; verify exhaustive name mapping and scheduler ratios; version independently

steps.purpose: U-Net scratch pipeline learnability sanity check if needed
steps.memory_gate: Use the same complete selected inputs only if they fit; no point cap disguised as a matched control
steps.limitation: A scratch U-Net versus an already-trained PTv3 is not an architecture-fair performance experiment

steps.requires: D0 mechanism report and diagnostic learnability evidence
steps.calibration: Same frozen 72 training-domain complete crops; inference artifacts only
steps.evaluation: Same frozen 195 tiles, 48m region and 24 complete trees on L1W
steps.stop_rule: No new TP and no seed-vote improvement at both nodes, or numerical/statistical failure; no automatic extension

scientific_boundaries: Current main's 3D GT/loss/heads/grouping remain the baseline; do not silently substitute historical paper settings
A PTv3-specific optimizer recipe is a new training variant, not the strict backbone-only control
Do not infer geometry is missing merely because feature channels are constant; xCPE/grid/serialization are present
Do not use overall XY error as the sole failure threshold; paper Appendix D losses use a different reference
Oracle arrays are diagnostic, never model performance or training input
Never resume training from the calibrated inference-only net
Wytham is excluded from current diagnosis, calibration and selection, and is not historically pristine in this project
No automatic concurrent launch of Local Split, other seeds or unrelated experiments
